The '''New Cylimba system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[D'Aelgoth sector/Legends|D'Aelgoth sector]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[New Cylimba]].
